verdict.rationale: Stripe documents public Radar API resources, including Reviews (e.g. POST /v1/reviews/:id/approve), Early Fraud Warnings and Value Lists, plus Radar Sessions, with machine-readable docs exposed via llms.txt and .md pages. However, custom rules appear to be configured in the Dashboard, and one community user cites a lack of easy programmatic control. missing for 10: documented API control of rules and risk settings, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probe paths returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven Radar workflows.
